instructions: Only caretaker and old friend have legible detailed pixel faces; all others obscured eye area. No runtime replacement.

items.title: 核心人物：那位客人、老管家
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a character concept sheet for the Chinese narrative bartending game 致未归的客人. Input image 1 is STYLE reference for the already approved cast, not characters to copy except merchant when requested. Match its hand-placed coarse-but-refined PIXEL ART clusters, natural adult anatomy, visible square pixels, clean stair-stepped contours, matte surfaces and limited color ramps. NOT chibi, NOT anime big eyes, NOT smooth painting with pixel filter, NO anti-aliased airbrush, no photoreal face, no glossy highlight or golden rim lighting. Head-to-upper-thigh portraits with hands and entire head in frame, believable anatomy, enough air between figures. Plain muted dark warm brown background, understated tiny cream Chinese labels below each figure, no ornate panels, no glitter. Each figure visually large, same adult scale. Pixel shadows remain sharp deliberate shapes. Produce an attractive usable art-direction concept, not a UI screenshot.
Landscape sheet of EXACTLY TWO characters, each with one large upper-thigh portrait and TWO small pixel face expression studies directly below. Facial features on THESE TWO characters must be carefully legible and emotionally distinctive, but entirely pixel art, no smooth eyes.
LEFT label 那位客人: male about 55, broad-medium shoulders, slightly long face, dark brown hair with grey temples combed back, clean shaven or extremely subtle stubble, NO HAT, no white moustache. Grey-brown well-fitting modest jacket, ivory open-collar shirt, small muted olive detail. Sitting relaxed at a bar implied only by pose (no furniture), holding a small stemmed coupe of naturally cobalt blue cocktail near waist, other hand holds folded recipe page. Thoughtful mildly skeptical expression, discerning but approachable, not aristocratic rich caricature. Tiny expression studies: skeptical then listening gentle smile, same identity.
RIGHT label 老管家: male about 70, slender tall narrow-shouldered build, silver grey side-part short hair, clean-shaven NO HAT NO MOUSTACHE, no resemblance to cowboy Hank in reference. Slate blue work waistcoat over light grey rolled-sleeve shirt, faded brown waist apron, modest keys at waist, both hands support a worn ledger. Slight stoop yet steady, intelligent attentive warm expression, practical caretaker not ceremonial tuxedo butler. Tiny studies: calm instruction then dry amused smile. Faces are detailed within reference pixel resolution, not tiny smooth portraits. Both should feel ordinary lived-in and emotionally credible.

items.title: 城市回忆：同事甲、同事乙、年轻同事
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a character concept sheet for the Chinese narrative bartending game 致未归的客人. Input image 1 is STYLE reference for the already approved cast, not characters to copy except merchant when requested. Match its hand-placed coarse-but-refined PIXEL ART clusters, natural adult anatomy, visible square pixels, clean stair-stepped contours, matte surfaces and limited color ramps. NOT chibi, NOT anime big eyes, NOT smooth painting with pixel filter, NO anti-aliased airbrush, no photoreal face, no glossy highlight or golden rim lighting. Head-to-upper-thigh portraits with hands and entire head in frame, believable anatomy, enough air between figures. Plain muted dark warm brown background, understated tiny cream Chinese labels below each figure, no ornate panels, no glitter. Each figure visually large, same adult scale. Pixel shadows remain sharp deliberate shapes. Produce an attractive usable art-direction concept, not a UI screenshot.
Wide landscape sheet EXACTLY THREE separate large portraits in one row. All three have deliberately UNREADABLE EYES and understated anonymous faces: broad pixel shadow planes across brow and upper face motivated by hair and a downward/sideward head angle; no discernible iris or pupil, no crisp white eye, no black censor rectangle, no Gaussian blur, no creepy hollow sockets. Noses/mouths only hinted with minimal quiet pixels, no detailed facial portrait. Silhouettes, clothing and props sharp. Modern ordinary office colleagues, not western costumes. Do not give anyone a cowboy hat. Full shoulders/hands/waist visible.
LEFT 同事甲: adult male ~38, slightly stocky square shoulders, short dark hair, taupe knit vest over pale blue collared shirt with sleeves casually rolled, charcoal trousers. Holds a plain coffee mug and thin folder, friendly open stance but gaze lowered and face under brow shadow. Normal human not villain.
CENTER 同事乙: adult woman ~35, narrow upright posture, tidy dark brown bob partly covering eye area, charcoal business blazer over light grey blouse, dark plum subtle accent, holds closed folder against chest, head turned slightly away. Understated anonymous face, no recognizable eyes, neutral restrained stance not sinister or sexy.
RIGHT 年轻同事: adult male ~25, slim but not childlike, slightly tousled dark hair covers eyes with soft-edged stepped PIXEL shadow, pale cream shirt and muted blue-grey cardigan, simple blank lanyard. One hand extends a brown packing tape roll, other holds worn notebook. Slight forward lean suggesting quiet concern; no cute expression, no detailed eyes.
Equal identity scale, warm muted earthy palette matching reference art even though modern clothing.

items.title: 日常人物：主角、投递员、调酒师、老板娘
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a character concept sheet for the Chinese narrative bartending game 致未归的客人. Input image 1 is STYLE reference for the already approved cast, not characters to copy except merchant when requested. Match its hand-placed coarse-but-refined PIXEL ART clusters, natural adult anatomy, visible square pixels, clean stair-stepped contours, matte surfaces and limited color ramps. NOT chibi, NOT anime big eyes, NOT smooth painting with pixel filter, NO anti-aliased airbrush, no photoreal face, no glossy highlight or golden rim lighting. Head-to-upper-thigh portraits with hands and entire head in frame, believable anatomy, enough air between figures. Plain muted dark warm brown background, understated tiny cream Chinese labels below each figure, no ornate panels, no glitter. Each figure visually large, same adult scale. Pixel shadows remain sharp deliberate shapes. Produce an attractive usable art-direction concept, not a UI screenshot.
Extra-wide landscape sheet EXACTLY FOUR figures with individual labels and generous spacing. All four have deliberately obscured/non-identifiable facial details: eyes hidden in a natural continuous muted PIXEL shadow plane from brow/hair/head angle, no visible pupils/irises, no smooth eyes, no detailed face, no censor bars, no horror black void face. Keep bodies and clothes crisp pixel art. Face lower plane only a few restrained nose/mouth marks. This is a narrative memory style.
LEFT label 主角: 35-year-old ordinary male, short dark slightly unkempt hair hiding eyes, head slightly lowered, blue-grey open-collar shirt with lightly creased rolled sleeves, charcoal trousers. Holds a modest cardboard box with a plain mug and worn dark notebook. Natural adult proportions, not impoverished caricature, no luxury logos.
SECOND label 投递员: female ~28, outdoorsy warm skin, short chestnut hair under a practical short-brim faded navy cap (NOT cowboy hat); cap shadows entire eye area. Indigo light work jacket, cream undershirt, tiny rust-red scarf, diagonal canvas mailbag strap and modest satchel at hip. Holding a receipt clipboard and pencil. Friendly capable posture but face remains anonymous.
THIRD label 调酒师: male ~38, charcoal rolled-sleeve shirt, chestnut brown long apron, short dark hair and face angled downward, eyes unidentifiable in pixel brow shadow. Polishing a clear glass with cream cloth near waist. Practical professional, no bow tie, no hat.
RIGHT label 老板娘: preserve identity-defining silhouette and clothing of LEFTMOST white-haired shopkeeper in input reference: long white/silver braid on one side, ivory rolled-sleeve blouse, brown fitted work vest, teal blue scarf, light apron, brown utility belt and pouch, holding a paper inventory list. Adult feminine proportions, attractive through shape and stance. For THIS prologue concept only obscure upper face with natural hair/brow pixel shadows and lowered gaze, NO recognizable shining golden eyes. No redesign of hair or outfit. Keep exact same art coarseness as other figures. Do not include Hank/Ada/Milo.
